name: Do I need a permit to install a fold-down shower seat in my home in the Bay Area?

mainEntity.name: Do I need a permit to install a fold-down shower seat in my home in the Bay Area?

acceptedAnswer.text: Typically, installing a fold-down shower seat as a standalone fixture does not require a building permit in most Bay Area jurisdictions, as it's often considered a minor alteration or accessory installation. However, if the installation is part of a larger bathroom renovation that involves significant plumbing, electrical, or structural changes, then a permit would likely be required for the overall project. It is always advisable to consult with your local building department or a licensed contractor like City Dweller, LLC for specific requirements in your city, such as Pacifica or Daly City.
acceptedAnswer.description: Standalone fold-down shower seat installation usually doesn't require a permit in the Bay Area. If part of a larger renovation, a permit may be needed. Always check with your local building department.
